name: EO Business Master File Extract
coverage: 1,984,891 orgs with an IRS determination (posting 2026-11-10); 1,659,108 are 501(c)(3); includes 393,222 group-ruling subordinates (affiliation 9) and 293,661 church-coded (foundation 10) records
data_format: CSV, 28 columns; 4 region files (343 MB) or 51 state + PR + intl files
update_frequency: Monthly extract; files Last-Modified Mon 2026-11-09, page posting 11/10
publication_latency: Status changes reach file within ~1 month of IRS master-file update; revoked orgs removed
historical_availability: None: cumulative current snapshot only; history requires self-archiving each month
reliability: High for identity/subsection/foundation code; NAME truncated to 70 chars; address = filing address
licensing_redistribution: US federal work: no copyright (17 USC 105); free redistribution
operational_dependencies: irs.gov availability; monthly snapshot archiving by consumer
known_omissions: Churches/integrated auxiliaries not required to apply; group subordinates absent unless central reported them; government units mostly absent; no DBA list; no 509(a)(3) type for many legacy code 17 records
failure_modes: Silent removal on revocation (no tombstone); stale foundation codes; EIN reuse after merger not flagged; schema/code drift; page date vs file date mismatch

name: Pub 78 data (TEOS)
authority: IRS (statutory reliance list under Rev. Proc. 2018-32)
coverage: 1,437,288 EINs eligible to receive deductible contributions; codes PC 1,263,533, PF 119,400, POF 9,441, SO 7,325, SONFI 307, SOUNK 14,137, GROUP 2,465 (+combinations), FORGN 731
data_format: Pipe-delimited text in ZIP (30 MB zip / 103 MB)
publication_latency: ~monthly; IRS says TEOS may show revoked org as eligible for a short time after IRB announcement
reliability: High (donor reliance list) but deliberately incomplete
known_omissions: Group subordinates (0 of 237,380 c3 subordinates listed), churches that never applied, governmental units, DBA names; 242,141 BMF 501(c)(3) EINs not in Pub 78
failure_modes: Lag after IRB revocations; 997 EINs in Pub 78 but not in BMF (cross-file inconsistency); legal name only

name: Automatic Revocation of Exemption List
coverage: 1,248,282 rows / 1,228,742 EINs revoked since 2010 for 3 years non-filing; 184,830 rows carry a reinstatement date
data_format: Pipe-delimited text in ZIP (48 MB zip / 148 MB); 12 fields incl. revocation date, posting date, reinstatement date
update_frequency: Monthly (2nd Tuesday); observed file 2026-11-17 with max posting 2026-11-11
publication_latency: Median 88 days between effective revocation date and posting (2026 postings; p90 115)
historical_availability: Cumulative since 2011 in one file (history included)
reliability: Medium: IRS notes 2020 dates systematically wrong; reinstatement field incomplete
known_omissions: Non-automatic (for-cause) revocations are not here; reinstatement may appear only via new determination
failure_modes: 31,616 EINs whose latest revocation has no reinstatement date are still in BMF (19,699 in Pub 78); retroactive reinstatement rewrites history; Apr-Jul 2020 date error; August batch spikes (~39-40k postings)

name: Form 990-N (e-Postcard) data
coverage: 1,557,850 EINs (latest e-Postcard per EIN); 670,928 for tax year 2025; 57,583 flagged terminated
data_format: Pipe-delimited text in ZIP (94 MB zip / 287 MB)
update_frequency: Weekly, generally Monday (Pub 5891); file 2026-11-23 while page label said Nov 9
historical_availability: Latest filing only (no history in file)
known_omissions: No financials; orgs with gross receipts > $50k file 990/990-EZ instead
failure_modes: Overwrite semantics: prior years lost unless archived; terminated flag must be treated as event; principal officer names = personal data

name: Form 990/990-EZ/990-PF/990-T e-file XML (TEOS)
data_format: XML per return in monthly ZIPs; yearly index CSV
publication_latency: Months: filing to posting; tax year lags filing year by 1-2 years
historical_availability: 2019 onward on IRS site; earlier years via third-party mirrors (GivingTuesday, AWS deprecated bucket)
reliability: High fidelity to filed data; schema versions vary
licensing_redistribution: Public domain (Schedule B donor info redacted except 990-PF)
cost: Free (~4.5 GB zipped per filing year)
failure_modes: Index column drift (2022 lacks XML_BATCH_ID); page links incomplete vs server; very large ZIPs (2022 02A 1.41 GB); amended/duplicate returns; filing year != tax year

name: Determination letters (TEOS)
coverage: Letters issued on/after 2014-01-01; foundation classification for 501(c)(3); reinstatement addenda
access_mechanism: Interactive TEOS search only; no documented bulk download; TEOS paths robots-disallowed
known_omissions: Pre-2014 letters; churches without letters; subordinates (central's group letter only)
failure_modes: No machine-readable fields; must OCR; robots disallow automated retrieval

name: Form 1023-EZ approvals
coverage: Approved 1023-EZ applications since 2014 with officers, state of incorporation, purposes
update_frequency: Extracted quarterly into annual summaries; latest listed year 2024 (page reviewed 2026-06-27)
reliability: Medium (column BZ error noted by IRS)
failure_modes: Annual lag; personal data handling

name: Section 501(p) suspensions
coverage: 9 organizations (names, cities)
failure_modes: Name-only matching; must be paired with OFAC SDN

name: Revocations of 501(c)(3) determinations (for cause)
coverage: Organizations revoked by IRS action (not automatic)
publication_latency: IRS: TEOS may lag IRB date; IRB date governs donor reliance
failure_modes: TEOS/Pub 78 lag behind IRB; name-only lookup in XLSX

name: SOI annual extract of EO financial data
coverage: Selected financial fields from 990/990-EZ/990-PF filed in a calendar year (latest: filed 2025)
failure_modes: Adjusted values differ from filed return

name: OFAC SDN and Consolidated (non-SDN) lists
coverage: SDN ~19.6k lines in SDN.CSV; consolidated ~0.5k primary rows; aliases and addresses
data_format: CSV (legacy), XML, Advanced Sanctions Data Model XML (129 MB SDN), delta files
access_mechanism: HTTPS GET sanctionslistservice.ofac.treas.gov/api/PublicationPreview/exports/<file>; SLS custom datasets; Sanctions List Search UI
update_frequency: No fixed schedule ('sporadic', 'ever increasing pace'); 10 action dates Oct 29-Nov 23 2026
historical_availability: Delta-file archive and archive of changes; full files current only
reliability: High (authoritative) but fuzzy matching yields false positives
licensing_redistribution: US federal work (no licence statement read)
operational_dependencies: SLS availability; Digest header for integrity
known_omissions: Non-US lists (UN, UK OFSI, EU) not included
failure_modes: Clerical updates listed by UID only; delta-only pipelines can drift (OFAC advises full refresh); weak aliases

name: California AG Registry 'May Not Operate or Solicit' list
authority: California DOJ Registry of Charities and Fundraisers
coverage: 29,536 orgs not in good standing (Revoked 23,516; Delinquent 3,936; Suspended 1,177; 907 cease-and-desist) with FEIN, SOS and registry numbers
publication_latency: Up to ~2 weeks; Registry Search Tool controls
reliability: High for adverse status; full registry not downloadable
licensing_redistribution: State government data; no explicit licence found (oag.ca.gov conditions silent on automation per b50-02)
known_omissions: Good-standing registrants (full registry is a session app with reCAPTCHA)
failure_modes: List stale between updates; full registry not scriptable

name: New York AG Charities Bureau registry
coverage: Registrations, annual financial reports (5 years), approved transactions
access_mechanism: Search UI with reCAPTCHA token; no data.ny.gov dataset
licensing_redistribution: State data; no open licence found
failure_modes: CAPTCHA blocks automation

name: State registries on open-data portals (e.g. CO SOS charities, CT DCP credentials)
coverage: State-specific registrants (CO with FEIN; CT name-only)
licensing_redistribution: Public Domain per dataset metadata (CO, CT)
known_omissions: Exempt categories (churches, small orgs); 'not found' != non-compliant
failure_modes: Mass due-date artefacts (CO Nov-15 notices); name-only joins

name: Other state charity registries (49 jurisdictions not verified here)
coverage: Varies; many states require solicitation registration, TX largely does not
access_mechanism: Mostly interactive; several CAPTCHA/robots-blocked (PA, WA, MA per b50-02)
failure_modes: Portal migrations; CAPTCHA; EIN not indexed (PA)

name: OpenCorporates (state corporate registry aggregator)
coverage: Company records from many registries incl. US states
licensing_redistribution: ODbL share-alike + attribution for free use; paid licence removes share-alike
commercial_use: Share-alike on free tier incompatible with proprietary registry; paid licence needed
cost: Free tier for open-data projects; paid otherwise (price not published)
known_omissions: Registries not covered; nonprofit status not tracked
failure_modes: Share-alike contamination of derived DB; rate limits

name: Census of Governments government units list
coverage: All US governmental units active 2022-06-30 (counties, municipalities, townships, special districts, school districts)
update_frequency: Quinquennial (2022; next 2027) with Government Units Survey updates
failure_modes: Units created/dissolved after census; EIN must be obtained from grantee

name: NCES Common Core of Data directory (schools, LEAs)
coverage: Public schools and school districts with NCES IDs
known_omissions: Private schools (see PSS); EINs; foundations of schools
failure_modes: Districts reorganise; NCES ID != EIN

name: IPEDS institutional data
coverage: Postsecondary institutions (UNITID), control (public/private), OPEID
failure_modes: Public universities are governmental (not in BMF); campus vs system identity

name: Charity Commission for England and Wales register
coverage: Registered charities in England and Wales (13 extract tables incl. trustees, annual returns per search result)
data_format: Daily extract JSON and TSV; REST API
access_mechanism: Bulk download (site returned 403 to agent); API with subscription key via developer hub
licensing_redistribution: Open Government Licence v3.0; acknowledge source; rate/quota limits
commercial_use: Permitted under OGL (no endorsement, no marketing use of personal data)
known_omissions: Excepted/exempt charities (e.g. some churches, universities) not registered
failure_modes: Agent blocking; key inactivity after 12 months; trustee personal data

name: Scottish Charity Register
coverage: All Scottish charities; 5-year annual returns file; trustee names from 9 Mar 2026
licensing_redistribution: OGL v3 plus conditions: no direct marketing; must not present as the Register; attribution statement
known_omissions: Cross-border charities registered in England only
failure_modes: Terms extra to OGL; API beta changes

name: CRA List of charities (T3010 open data) and qualified donees
coverage: Registered charities: identification, financial core, qualified donees gifted, directors
access_mechanism: open.canada.ca CKAN API and downloads (robots allows)
update_frequency: Annual (P1Y); 2025 dataset modified 2026-11-18; live search updated continuously
known_omissions: Other qualified donees (municipalities, foreign universities) are separate web lists; directors = personal data
failure_modes: Annual lag vs status changes (revocations) - use live list for status

name: ACNC Charity Register dataset
coverage: Registered Australian charities (withheld charities excluded)
access_mechanism: Download (data.gov.au robots disallows all and returned 403 to agent)
licensing_redistribution: CC BY 3.0 AU (search result; AIS years vary CC BY 2.5/3.0)
failure_modes: robots/403 for automated agents: needs manual or permitted channel

name: NGOsource equivalency determinations
coverage: Foreign NGOs with ED certificates in repository
failure_modes: Expiry; per-grantor licensing; not public

name: Candid (GuideStar) APIs
coverage: ~1.9m US orgs (vendor claim)
licensing_redistribution: Proprietary; AI/ML extraction needs written consent; delete on termination

coverage: ~245k rated of ~1.7m profiles (vendor claims)
